evidence: The use of emerging technologies by organized cyber criminals, such as artificial intelligence and quantum computing, has increased the range of security threats faced by the Company.
Cybersecurity threats are constantly expanding and evolving, becoming increasingly sophisticated and complex, increasing the difficulty of detecting and defending against them
ai_positioning.summary: AIN adopte une posture défensive vis-à-vis de l'IA, mentionnant principalement les risques de cybermenaces utilisant l'IA par des acteurs malveillants plutôt que d'explorer des opportunités d'intégration ou de développement technologique.
